learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how the human immune system fights off invisible invaders, and explore common diseases, their causes, and how to stay healthy!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Diseases can be caused by bacteria (Typhoid, Pneumonia), viruses (Common cold, Dengue), fungi (Ringworm), and protozoans (Malaria, Amoebiasis). Vector-borne diseases like Malaria rely on mosquitoes to spread.

Innate immunity is what you're born with—physical barriers (skin), physiological barriers (stomach acid), and cellular defenders (macrophages). Acquired immunity is developed over your lifetime; it is pathogen-specific and creates a 'memory' of past infections.

When an unknown antigen (foreign particle) enters the body, B-lymphocytes produce a massive army of Y-shaped proteins called Antibodies ($H_2L_2$ structure) that specifically lock onto and destroy that antigen.

AIDS is caused by HIV, a retrovirus that destroys T-helper cells, leaving the body defenseless against simple infections. Cancer occurs when normal cells lose the property of 'contact inhibition' and divide uncontrollably to form tumors.

Substances like opioids, cannabinoids, and coca alkaloids target the central nervous system. Addiction alters the brain's receptors, leading to dependence and severe withdrawal symptoms if stopped suddenly.

fun_activity.title: 🤧 The Sneeze Zone
fun_activity.instructions: Fill a spray bottle with colored water and spray it once into the air against a large piece of white paper. Look at the spread of the tiny droplets! This visually demonstrates exactly how airborne diseases like the common cold and pneumonia spread.

exam_tips: 📌 Master the complete life cycle of *Plasmodium* (Malaria). Know where the sexual stage happens (mosquito gut) and where the asexual stage happens (human liver and RBCs).
📌 Be able to draw and label the typical Y-shaped structure of an antibody molecule.
📌 Differentiate between Active immunity (your body makes antibodies, slow) and Passive immunity (ready-made antibodies are given, like anti-tetanus or mother's milk, fast).
quick_recap: ⭐ The principle of vaccination is based on the property of 'memory' of the immune system.
⭐ Benign tumors remain confined to their original location, but malignant tumors spread to other parts of the body (Metastasis).
⭐ *Salmonella typhi*, the bacteria that causes Typhoid, is confirmed using the Widal test.
